thread:
Nora (Product): Quick sync: we need final decisions for the Usage & Billing dashboard UI. Main tension: card/grid layout vs. stacked list for spend + model token breakdowns. Also invoices discovery/retention and CSV schema. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ghi

Dan (Design): Two proposals in file: Grid cards (Spend chart, Token heatmap, Top projects, Invoice timeline) vs. Stacked list with a left filter rail. Grid is denser and scannable on wide screens; stacked is simpler for accessibility and mobile.

Carlos (Eng): Tech constraints: token heatmap (project x model) for orgs with >200 projects is heavy. We can precompute top-50 projects and top-10 models, and stream detail on demand. Heatmap rendering on the client should use canvas for perf.

Mei (Finance): Invoice requirements: downloadable CSV with columns: invoice_id, invoice_date, project_id, model, tokens_prompt, tokens_completion, tokens_total, unit_price, line_amount, tax_amount, proration_start, proration_end, billing_address. Need retention: store PDFs for 24 months. Please don't hide downloads behind too many clicks.

Zoe (Support): Customers often ask for route-level breakdowns. Can we add a "drill to route" action from the project row? Also helpful: a "why did cost change" quick view that shows top delta contributors.

Dan (Design): Accessibility notes: avoid tiny interactive areas in the grid; ensure keyboard focus order is linear. For the heatmap, add a textual table fallback and aria-describedby on hover cells. Use textures/patterns instead of color-only encoding.

Nora (Product): Proposed decisions: 1) Use stacked list on mobile and grid cards on desktop (responsive). 2) Default Overview shows 30d spend with quick toggles 7/30/90. 3) Token heatmap: show top N Projects x top M Models, with "Show all" that triggers server-side job or CSV export. 4) Billing tab for invoices with CSV/PDF export and retention policy.

Carlos (Eng): Implementation notes: endpoints: `/v1/billing/overview?range=30d&org_id=...`, `/v1/billing/heatmap?org_id=&top_projects=50&top_models=10`, `/v1/billing/invoices?org_id=&format=csv&start=&end=`. We'll include `data_freshness` and `source` fields in responses. Use signed URLs for downloads with short TTL and audit logs.

billing-bot: Notice: spike detected 2025-06-11T09:30Z on `/v1/billing/heatmap` p95=3.6s, related to large org queries. Suggest pre-aggregation and rate limiting.

Carlos (Eng): We'll add server-side rate limits for heavy heatmap calls and queue full exports as background jobs. Client should show progress and a notification when CSV is ready.

Mei (Finance): CSV schema request: please include token totals per line and a mapping doc for customers. Also add VAT number on PDF header and a note about proration.

Dan (Design): UX copy: header should read "Viewing: Organization — <Org Name> (scope: All projects)". Export button: "Export invoice CSV" not just "Export". Add a small help panel in Billing tab: "How to read this invoice".

Zoe (Support): For the "why did cost change" flow, show delta per model and per project plus recent deploys note. If deploy info is not available, show a hint to check routes.

Nora (Product): Action items: Dan to update responsive mocks and patterns (24h). Carlos to spec APIs and the signed-URL flow + ETA (tomorrow). Mei to provide CSV fixtures and legal invoice copy (EOD). Zoe to draft the support help card copy.

Dan (Design): Will add pattern fills, keyboard nav notes, and the textual fallback view in Figma. Also will prototype mobile stacked behavior.

Carlos (Eng): ETA: overview + staleness badge + export CTA = 1 sprint. Heatmap with top-N defaults + background export job = 1 sprint. Invoices tab + signed URL + retention = 1 sprint. RBAC for downloads required; need auth team availability.

Mei (Finance): I'll share CSV mock and PDF template today. Also request tests for CSV schema.

billing-bot: Task created: billing-export-job queued by Carlos at 2025-06-12T07:15Z.

Nora (Product): Quick poll: prefer grid on desktop? React with :one: for grid, :two: for stacked.

Dan (Design): :one:
Carlos (Eng): :one:
Mei (Finance): :two: (leans stacked for clarity)
Zoe (Support): :two:

Nora (Product): Mixed — we'll default to responsive: grid desktop, stacked mobile. I'll create tickets and link updated figma when ready. Closing thread for now. Ping here for blockers.
